name: Half-Life 30
source:
"By the time a man turns 50, half of their life is over."

A man walks into the flickering light of a dim bar,
letting the doors swing closed behind him.

Rain trickles down his jacket as he strolls to the counter.

He takes off his coat, carefully placing the leather around the back of a barstool.

"Slow night, isn't it?"

[from [url=https://kikid484.itch.io/half-life-30]itch.io[/url]]

(Note: This game has no relation to the Half-Life franchise, and the name was simply chosen for thematic purposes)
